title: A dual-branch perception and hybrid attention integrated framework for temporal remote estimation of wheat leaf biomass.
summary: A temporal model estimated wheat-leaf biomass from remote imagery with reported field performance.

evidence.tested: DBAFN was evaluated against destructive leaf-biomass measurements from 60 plots and independent experiments across other regions/genotypes; reported R² was 0.87 in the primary setting and 0.816–0.820 in independent experiments.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Uses parallel temporal-convolution branches, hybrid attention and a Transformer encoder to estimate wheat leaf biomass from UAV time-series observations.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
